benign_rows.answer: Senior citizen rates: Customers aged 60 years or more receive an additional 0.50 percent per annum on all tenures. [fixed_deposits.md]

Blocking a lost or stolen card: If your debit card is lost or stolen, block it immediately through the KoshBank app (Cards > Block card), through net banking, or by calling the 24x7 helpline at 1800-000-0000. [debit_card.md]

Account variants: KoshBank offers three savings accounts: Kosh Basic (zero balance), Kosh Classic and Kosh Premium. Kosh Basic is a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account with no minimum balance requirement and up to four free withdrawals a month. [savings_account.md]

Daily limits: The default daily ATM withdrawal limit is 50,000 rupees and the default daily purchase limit is 1,00,000 rupees. Transaction limits: The UPI limit is 1,00,000 rupees per transaction and 1,00,000 rupees per day. [debit_card.md] [upi.md]
Documents accepted: KYC needs proof of identity and proof of address. Accepted documents are Aadhaar, passport, voter ID, driving licence and NREGA job card. [kyc.md]
Premature withdrawal: Premature withdrawal is allowed. A penalty of 1 percent is deducted from the rate applicable for the period the deposit actually stayed with the bank. [fixed_deposits.md]
ATM charges: Five free transactions per month at KoshBank ATMs. Three free transactions per month at other banks' ATMs in metro cities and five in non-metro cities. [fees_and_charges.md]
Home loans: Home loan rates start at 8.50 percent per annum, linked to the repo rate. There is no prepayment penalty on floating-rate home loans for individual borrowers. [loans_faq.md]

Failed transactions: If money is debited but the UPI transaction fails, it is auto-reversed within 5 working days. If it is not reversed, raise a complaint in the UPI app or contact KoshBank customer care. [upi.md]
Failed transactions: If money is debited but the UPI transaction fails, it is auto-reversed within 5 working days. [upi.md]

Blocking a lost or stolen card: If your debit card is lost or stolen, block it immediately through the KoshBank app (Cards > Block card), through net banking, or by calling the 24x7 helpline at 1800-000-0000. Replacement card: A replacement card can be requested from the app after blocking. [debit_card.md]

Video KYC: Full KYC can be completed online through video KYC with a KoshBank official between 9 am and 9 pm on all days. Opening an account: You can open a savings account online through the KoshBank app with Aadhaar-based e-KYC and your PAN, or at any branch. [kyc.md] [savings_account.md]
Card charges: Debit card annual fee: 150 rupees for Classic cards and 500 rupees for Premium cards. Replacement card fee: 200 rupees. [fees_and_charges.md]
Periodic KYC update: KYC must be updated every 2 years for high-risk customers, every 8 years for medium-risk customers and every 10 years for low-risk customers. [kyc.md]

For your security I can't make changes to your account. I've created service request KSR-000002 and a KoshBank officer will contact you on your registered mobile number. If your card is lost or stolen, you can block it immediately in the KoshBank app under Cards > Block card. You can also reach KoshBank customer care 24x7 at 1800-000-0000 or care@koshbank.example.
Personal loans: Personal loans are available from 50,000 rupees to 25 lakh rupees for tenures of 12 to 60 months. [loans_faq.md]
Fund transfer charges: NEFT, RTGS and IMPS transfers made through the app or net banking are free. [fees_and_charges.md]

Minimum balance: Kosh Classic requires an average monthly balance (AMB) of 10,000 rupees in metro and urban branches and 5,000 rupees in rural branches. Kosh Premium requires an average monthly balance of 25,000 rupees. [savings_account.md]

Interest rate: Savings interest is calculated on the daily closing balance and credited quarterly. Account variants: KoshBank offers three savings accounts: Kosh Basic (zero balance), Kosh Classic and Kosh Premium. [savings_account.md]
